scope: Design and prospectively freeze the smallest scientifically useful CME FX MBP-10 pilot. Design only. No data download, no model fit, no backtest, no 2018+ access.

philosophy.v1_v3_lesson: Large candidate searches on price-only FX M1 are not useful. V4 must not repeat that structure.

staged_access.positive_P1_does_not_authorize: Opening external validation in the same run.

sampling.selection_rule: For every instrument x calendar month in dev/int-val: enumerate eligible CME trading dates using calendar/contract metadata only; compute hash; sort dates by hash; select first 4 eligible full-session dates.
sampling.estimated_total: 4 days/month x 15 months x 3 instruments = 180 instrument-days
sampling.partial_sessions: Follow frozen quality semantics from capability contract. Do NOT substitute using outcomes.

instruments.eligibility: Frozen per-date contract eligibility + 5-trading-day roll (from capability contract V2).
instruments.no_reduction_later: Do not reduce to only the best-looking instrument later.

orientation_guard.6E: USD per EUR. Price up = EUR strengthens.
orientation_guard.6J: USD per JPY. Price up = JPY STRENGTHENS (inverse of spot USDJPY).
orientation_guard.6B: USD per GBP. Price up = GBP strengthens.
orientation_guard.note: Numerical orientation comes from frozen quotation semantics, NOT from cosmetic pair labels.

P0_PRICE_ONLY_BASELINE.description: Derived from same CME feed WITHOUT book-size/trade-flow.
features: contract/session calendar controls (hour-of-day, day-of-week, session-start proximity)

P1_TRADE_FLOW.unknown_handling: UNKNOWN (N) trades remain unsigned. No forced signing.

I10_multi_level_imbalance.formula: I10 = sum_l w_l * (bid_sz_l - ask_sz_l) / sum_l w_l * (bid_sz_l + ask_sz_l)
I10_multi_level_imbalance.note: ONE frozen weighting function. Do NOT test ten weighting schemes.

OFI_market_by_price.note: Computed from successive authoritative MBP-10 embedded states. NOT from manual book mutation.

windows.constraint: Every feature must end STRICTLY before the prediction anchor. No use of the target event.

clock_time.frequency: one anchor every 30 seconds during certified active session
clock_time.book_state: last valid book state STRICTLY before the anchor

event_time.frequency: one anchor every 500 eligible MBP-10 events
event_time.book_state: state at the 500th event (exclusive of next 500)

anchors.rationale: Reduces pseudo-replication and compute. Dependence handled statistically at DAY level.

targets.definition: Target = (mid_{t+H} - mid_t) / tick_size, in ticks. mid = (bid_px_00 + ask_px_00) / 2. Direction-neutral. Starts strictly after feature cutoff. Unavailable/corrupt intervals yield no example.
targets.secondary_diagnostic: All previously frozen horizons (1s, 5s, 30s, 1m, 5m clock; 10, 50, 100, 500 event) may be archived diagnostically but CANNOT determine pilot success.

H1_TRADE_FLOW.statement: P0 + P1 improves short-horizon prediction over P0.

H2_TOP_OF_BOOK.statement: P0 + P2 improves prediction over P0.

H3_DEPTH.statement: P0 + P2 + P3 improves prediction over P0 + P2.
H3_DEPTH.note: Directly asks whether true L2 adds information beyond BBO.

H4_EVENT_TIME.statement: The frozen microstructure model in event-time contains incremental predictive information not captured by the equivalent clock-time representation.
H4_EVENT_TIME.comparison: Ridge(P0+P1+P2+P3, event-time) vs Ridge(P0+P1+P2+P3, clock-time) on T3

H5_COST_AWARE.statement: Predicted edge magnitude is monotonically related to subsequently realized executable net opportunity after observed bid/ask + frozen USD/contract/side fees.
H5_COST_AWARE.note: NOT a trading strategy optimization. Cannot rescue failed predictive hypotheses.

model.target: future signed mid move in ticks
model.alpha_selection: Blocked chronological CV inside DEVELOPMENT ONLY
forbidden: hyperparameter search beyond frozen alpha set

cv.purge_embargo: Embargo >= 5 minutes (largest frozen diagnostic horizon) at fold boundaries
cv.no_future_influence: No event from a future block can influence scaling/model choice in a past block

internal_validation.period: 2016-10-01 to 2017-03-31, selected deterministic P1 days only
internal_validation.frozen_after_dev: After model/hyperparameter selection on DEVELOPMENT, freeze the fitted procedure.

metrics.critical: paired DAILY loss difference between enriched model and its frozen baseline
metrics.rationale: Prevents millions of correlated events from manufacturing tiny p-values.

inference.multiplicity: Holm correction for H1-H4 (four predictive hypotheses)
inference.H5_handling: Separately identified as secondary economic calibration. NOT allowed to rescue failed predictive hypotheses.
additional_reports: fraction of instrument-days with positive loss improvement

pass_fail.rule: A predictive hypothesis passes ONLY if ALL hold:
criteria: 2. Pooled validation loss improves over baseline
4. Effect direction is positive in at least 2 of 3 instruments

h5_calibration.method: Fixed decile bins of predicted |edge| / estimated round-trip cost
h5_calibration.question: Does larger predicted edge/cost ratio correspond monotonically to larger realized net opportunity?

go_no_go.proceed_if: At least ONE of H1, H2, H3, H4 passes the full frozen predictive criterion after Holm correction.

protocol_era.stratified_reporting: Future validation must report results stratified by protocol era (external period crosses MDP2->MDP3)

acquisition_manifest.symbol_resolution: Only Definition/Status metadata may be used to resolve contract symbols before outcome retrieval.

firewall.code_level_enforcement: Firewall must be implemented in acquisition code before any data request is made.

metadata_preflight.note: No API key. Exact commands for P1 SAMPLE (not full multi-year).
metadata_preflight.aggregate: Sum records, GB, estimated USD cost across all selected instrument-days.
metadata_preflight.contract_resolution: Minimal outcome-free workflow: use Definition schema metadata to resolve raw contract symbols for each selected date. No MBP-10 data returned.

next_gate.name: V4_PILOT_METADATA_COST_PREFLIGHT
next_gate.scope: Obtain real metadata estimates; verify selected contract symbols; report exact data cost/size; download ZERO MBP-10 market outcomes. Only after user accepts real cost should a later gate acquire P1 data.
